request.style: English, male solo voice, rustic and somber, acoustic guitar, cello, tambourine, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Lord showed me a sight
A basket of summer fruit
He asked what I see, Amos
I answered the Lord's truth

[Chorus]
The end has come for Israel
I will never pass them by
The time of grace is finished
Under the open sky

[Verse]
On that day the palace sings
But the song turns to wailing
The temple songs are broken
The joy is now failing

[Chorus]
The end has come for Israel
I will never pass them by
The time of grace is finished
Under the open sky

[Bridge]
Corpses everywhere are found
Flung out in silence deep
No one hears the lament
As the secrets sleep

[Outro]
The end has come for Israel
The basket holds the day
